verbalization: Terricollene B appears to have multiple targets that ultimately lead to Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The first pathway links Terricollene B to Interferon alpha/beta receptor (IFNAR), which is targeted by Ertugliflozin, and Ertugliflozin in turn targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The second pathway connects Terricollene B to ADP-ribosylation factor-like protein 3, which is targeted by Morelloflavone, and Morelloflavone also targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. These two distinct pathways suggest that Terricollene B may act through different mechanisms to influence the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The shared target of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3 in both pathways implies a potential role for these compounds in modulating the transporter's activity. The integration of these evidence points highlights the possibility that Terricollene B and Morelloflavone may exert their effects through different molecular pathways, yet both contribute to the regulation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3.
